product_tree_scheme: SHA-256 over Git-tracked paths in src, database, public, scripts, package.json, package-lock.json and next.config.ts, byte-sorted. Each path, NUL, then raw SHA-256 of its content.
scope: M1.01.01 exact product and isolated PostgreSQL/loopback TLS. QA assertions were prepared locally. Live provider availability and production hosting are separate.

cases.positive: App and script validators accepted valid configuration and the owned production entry point started with independent secrets on PostgreSQL.
cases.invalid_input: Each missing secret and each prohibited production demo or sandbox setting failed entry-point validation before a listener started.
cases.permission_isolation: Protected perimeter, Worker denial of Admin access, authorized Admin access, and omission of configured secrets and database URL from sampled responses passed.
cases.retry_recovery: Invalid startup returned an outage, corrected startup recovered on the same fixture, and graceful and forced restart released and reacquired the owned listener.
cases.persistence: Worker and Admin sessions survived restart. The same signing key authenticated the original credential before and after restart with unchanged signed fields and a working public verification capability.
cases.downstream_outcome: Operator validation printed production, PostgreSQL and the matching release identity. Admin operations identified disabled email/SMS, built-in video, and configured but unverified scanning.

observations.scope: 14 environment and production entry point checks passed.
Exact production configuration, operators, role denial, outage and retained sessions passed.
Exact credential signature authority, retained signed fields, existing public capability and recipient continuity passed.
Compiled standalone manifest and process source agreed.
